title: 0062 재고 구매 발주 — 두 표 모두 서버만, 발주 넣기 · 입고 · 취소가 입고 예정 · 재고와 같이 움직인다 (scripts/rls-probe.mjs --migration database/migrations/0062_stock_orders.sql — 0059 적용 뒤)
setup: INSERT INTO public.companies (id, kind, name, plan, status) VALUES ({{company_x}}, 'partner', 'probe X', 'agent', 'active'), ({{company_y}}, 'partner', 'probe Y', 'expert', 'active')
INSERT INTO public.company_members (company_id, user_id, role, status) VALUES ({{company_x}}, {{x_owner_user}}, 'owner', 'active')

INSERT INTO public.stock_items (id, company_id, kind, name, unit, qty, active) VALUES ({{item_a}}, {{company_x}}, 'hardware', 'probe 경첩', '개', 40, true), ({{item_b}}, {{company_x}}, 'hardware', 'probe 레일', '쌍', 5, true), ({{item_off}}, {{company_x}}, 'hardware', 'probe 숨김', '개', 0, false), ({{item_y}}, {{company_y}}, 'board', 'probe PB', '장', 5, true)

checks.name: 발주 읽기 — 서버만 (대표도 브라우저로는 못 읽는다). 번호는 1부터
checks.sql: select seq || '/' || state from public.stock_orders where company_id = {{company_x}}

checks.name: 발주 넣기 함수 — 구성원은 못 부른다
발주를 넣으면 품목의 입고 예정이 그만큼 는다
checks.sql: select expected_qty || '/' || (expected_on = current_date + 3) from public.stock_items where id = {{item_a}}

checks.name: 숨긴 품목 · 남의 업체 품목은 발주 못 한다
checks.sql: select public.stock_order_place({{company_x}}, NULL, current_date + 1, NULL, jsonb_build_array(jsonb_build_object('item_id', {{item_off}}, 'qty', 1)), NULL)

checks.name: 남의 업체 품목
checks.sql: select public.stock_order_place({{company_x}}, NULL, current_date + 1, NULL, jsonb_build_array(jsonb_build_object('item_id', {{item_y}}, 'qty', 1)), NULL)

checks.name: 입고(그대로) — 재고가 늘고 입고 예정이 지워지고 발주가 닫힌다
checks.sql: select (public.stock_order_receive({{company_x}}, id, {{x_owner_user}})).state || '/' || (select qty || '/' || coalesce(expected_qty::text, '-') from public.stock_items where id = {{item_a}}) from public.stock_orders where company_id = {{company_x}} and seq = 1

checks.name: 입고(덜 옴) — 들어온 만큼만 늘고, 덜 온 만큼도 입고 예정에서 빠진다
checks.sql: select (public.stock_order_receive({{company_x}}, o.id, NULL, (select jsonb_object_agg(l.id::text, 5) from public.stock_order_lines l where l.order_id = o.id and l.item_id = {{item_b}}))).state || '/' || (select qty || '/' || coalesce(expected_qty::text, '-') from public.stock_items where id = {{item_b}}) from public.stock_orders o where o.company_id = {{company_x}} and o.seq = 1

checks.name: 취소 — 입고 예정에서 빠지고 닫힌다
checks.sql: select (public.stock_order_cancel({{company_x}}, id, NULL)).state || '/' || (select coalesce(expected_qty::text, '-') from public.stock_items where id = {{item_b}}) from public.stock_orders where company_id = {{company_x}} and seq = 1

checks.name: 남의 업체 id 로는 없는 발주
checks.sql: select public.stock_order_receive({{company_y}}, id, NULL) from public.stock_orders where company_id = {{company_x}} and seq = 1
